Cut 12 rounds from the pastry and press into a greased muffin tin.Cook the leeks gently in the butter with the thyme leaves for 12 minutes until soft and sweet.Whisk the eggs, cream, salt and pepper.Divide the leeks and gruyère between the cases and pour over the egg mix.Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
